newsitem.title: USA: IMP hit with class action suit.
newsitem.headline: IMP hit with class action suit.

text.p: Two shareholders of IMP Inc said they have filed a class action suit against the company, alleging the company and certain of its officers violated state corporate codes.

Plaintiffs, being represented by San Diego-based Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, contend the company made positive statements about product demand and backlog that helped drive the stock price higher.
The plaintiffs claim eight insiders sold the stock near its highs in May before disclosing a poor sales performance due to weak product demand.
A spokesman for the was not immediately available.
Plaintiffs said their suit covers shareholders who purchased the stock from April 24, 1996 to July 22, 1996.
